 Rules are rules.

 Ayari makes amends published at 15:13 GMT 15:13 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at Etihad Stadium 
 Image source, Getty Images Just like they did on Wednesday, Brighton take the lead against Manchester City.
 It's Yasin Ayari who bags from close range. He makes amends after missing one of the penalties in the shootout during the week.
 334 99 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:12 GMT 15:12 GMT 
 Hull City 0-0 Ipswich Town 
 The first shot on target and it comes from Julio Enciso for Ipswich. He scored from range in the 1-1 draw against Nottingham Forest but Konstantinos Tzolakis dives to his right and holds the ball for what turns out to be a routine save.
 96 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Bournemouth 0-1 Leeds published at 15:11 GMT 15:11 GMT 
 Dominic Calvert-Lewin (11 mins) 
 What a move that is. 
 It's absolutely brilliant play from Leeds to find James Justin in space on the right side and he sends the ball to Dominic Calvert-Lewin with his first touch. 
 It's saved by Djordje Petrovic initially but is bundled over the line by Calvert-Lewin's arm. 
 VAR will check...
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1001 276 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Man City 0-1 Brighton published at 15:11 GMT 15:11 GMT 
 Yasin Ayari (11 mins) 
 Image source, Getty Images Just as they did on Wednesday, Brighton go ahead!
 It comes from a Lewis Dunk free-kick which is knocked across the penalty box by Maxim de Cuyper.
 Matheus Nunes should do better but he can't prevent it from reaching Yasin Ayari and the Seagulls have the lead.
 2199 519 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:11 GMT 15:11 GMT 
 Brentford 0-0 Nottm Forest 
 Liam Delap receives the ball with his back to goal and he swivels quickly, trying to get a shot away on the half volley.
 He completely mistimes it and his strike flies into the stands.
 50 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Martinez's red 'huge moment' in game - Carrick published at 15:10 GMT 15:10 GMT 
 FT: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Manchester United 
 Manchester United boss Michael Carrick, speaking to MOTD: "We were more in the game first half. 
 "Felt we should have been ahead. The game ended up getting away from us. The first goal is not a good goal to concede. After that, we never got the game to where we got in the first half.
 "Not a good goal from our point of view at all."
 On Lisandro Martinez's red card: "It has a major importance on the game. A huge moment. I think that is pretty obvious really."
 On Bryan Mbeumo hitting the crossbar: "Probably summed it up really. Great strike from Bryan at the point. We would have been right in the game again. You back the lads to score, you back the lads to create chances.
 "Bryan is one who epitomised how the game went."
 On Bruno Fernandes: "I was happy with the team first half, especially individually in it. The discipline, the role, the quality of the football were all there."

 Man City 0-0 Brighton 
 Jeremy Doku goes to strike the ball and the block means it whips up and hits Diego Gomez on the underside of his arm.
 Manchester City of course appeal for a penalty but there was nothing Gomez could've done about that.

 The first sight of goal and it comes from Ipswich as Abdoul Ouattara skips away from Nobel Mendy down the right wing but the ball into the middle is easily dealt with by home goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis.
 42 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Brighton fans are feeling confident' published at 15:09 GMT 15:09 GMT 
 Manchester City 0-0 Brighton 
 John Bennett 
BBC Final Score reporter at the Etihad 
 Image source, Getty Images You’d think that the Brighton fans would be sick of the sight of this place following Wednesday’s penalty shoot out defeat and a record which reads no wins in 16 away league games at Manchester City.
 But the travelling supporters I’ve been speaking to this afternoon are confident not only because they’ve held Man City to draws here in their last two Premier League meetings but also because of their goalscoring prowess.
 A Brighton side with 23 goals already in this league campaign will feel they can test a Man City defence that hasn’t kept a clean sheet in 5 games and a Man City keeper in Gianluigi Donnarumma who’s under the spotlight after a big error last Saturday at Aston Villa.
 Is this the day when Brighton finally get a win at the Etihad Stadium?

Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Image source, Getty Images Brighton have started the season oh so well. 
 A little blip as of late but we know that they are going to be brave and bold and press Manchester City.

 Coventry win an early corner but it's nodded wide at the far post.
 A crucial three points up for grabs for both of these sides today.
 34 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Two promoted sides that have made solid starts' published at 15:06 GMT 15:06 GMT 
 Hull City 0-0 Ipswich Town 
 Niall McCaughan 
BBC Final Score at the MKM Stadium 
 Two promoted sides that have made solid starts to life back in the Premier League meet at the MKM Stadium today. 
 Yes, there is still a long way to go, but both Hull and Ipswich would have been targeting survival as their main ambition this season.
 When you consider Sunderland's struggles, Crystal Palace's problems and how Forest are floundering, both sets of supporters may be feeling quietly confident that they have already gained enough traction to stay up.
 Add to that the mess Manchester United are in at the moment, and the fact that we still await the outcome of Manchester City's guilty verdict, the signs look good for both teams. Three points for either side would be huge for their respective causes.
 38 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing

 Mamadou Sangare caught that, didn't he?
 A Brentford corner is headed out to him on the edge of the box and he takes it first time on the volley, catching it cleanly and whipping it just over the crossbar.
